mapper.sql: SELECT p.payment_id, p.contract_id, p.fee_type, p.fee_name, p.period_start, p.period_end, p.amount_due, p.amount_paid, p.pay_deadline, p.pay_time, p.pay_status, p.remind_status, p.remind_time, p.remark, p.park_id, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.direction, p.tax_rate, p.special_bill_type, p.late_fee_start_days, p.late_fee_ratio, p.late_fee_cap, p.company_name, p.attachment_name, p.attachment_url, p.payment_voucher_name, p.payment_voucher_url, p.selected_room_ids, p.selected_room_name, p.selected_building_name, c.contract_no, c.customer_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.customer_name, ''), cu.enterprise_name) AS customer_name, cu.credit_code, cu.registered_address, c.address_change_status, c.address_change_address, c.address_change_time, c.address_change_by, c.contract_name, COALESCE(p.selected_room_name, c.room_name) AS room_name, COALESCE(p.selected_building_name, c.building_name) AS building_name, c.contract_status, CASE c.contract_status WHEN '0' THEN '待审批' WHEN '1' THEN '生效' WHEN '2' THEN '已到期' WHEN '3' THEN '已续签' WHEN '4' THEN '已退租' WHEN '5' THEN '待盖章' WHEN '6' THEN '退租中' WHEN '7' THEN '退租交接中' WHEN '8' THEN '房屋验收中' ELSE '未知' END AS contract_status_name, pay_cwr.process_ins_id AS payment_process_ins_id, pay_cwr.process_status AS payment_approval_status, pay_cwr.approval_time AS payment_approval_time, pay_cwr.current_node AS payment_current_node_name, pay_cwr.print_file_url AS payment_file_url, law_cwr.process_ins_id AS overdue_process_ins_id, law_cwr.process_status AS overdue_approval_status, law_cwr.current_node AS overdue_current_node_name, law_cwr.print_file_url AS overdue_file_url, term_cwr.process_ins_id AS termination_process_ins_id, term_cwr.process_status AS termination_approval_status, term_cwr.current_node AS termination_current_node_name, term_cwr.print_file_url AS termination_file_url FROM biz_contract_payment p LEFT JOIN biz_contract c ON c.contract_id = p.contract_id LEFT JOIN biz_customer cu ON cu.customer_id = c.customer_id AND COALESCE(cu.del_flag, '0') = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM biz_contract_workflow_record WHERE business_type = 'contract_payment' AND COALESCE(process_def_key, '') != 'invoice' AND COALESCE(process_def_key, '') != 'offline-deposit-refund' AND COALESCE(form_key, '') != 'invoice' AND COALESCE(template_key, '') != 'invoice-apply' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) latest_pay_cwr ON latest_pay_cwr.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN biz_contract_workflow_record pay_cwr ON pay_cwr.record_id = latest_pay_cwr.record_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM biz_contract_workflow_record WHERE business_type = 'contract_overdue_legal' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY payment_id ) latest_law_cwr ON latest_law_cwr.payment_id = p.payment_id LEFT JOIN biz_contract_workflow_record law_cwr ON law_cwr.record_id = latest_law_cwr.record_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contract_id, MAX(record_id) AS record_id FROM biz_contract_workflow_record WHERE business_type = 'contract_termination' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY contract_id ) latest_term_cwr ON latest_term_cwr.contract_id = p.contract_id LEFT JOIN biz_contract_workflow_record term_cwr ON term_cwr.record_id = latest_term_cwr.record_id
mapper.select: WHERE p.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY p.period_start ASC, p.payment_id ASC
SELECT * FROM biz_contract_payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM biz_contract_payment WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND COALESCE(direction, 'receivable') = 'receivable' AND COALESCE(pay_status, '0') != '1' AND COALESCE(special_bill_type, '') != 'termination_cancelled' AND (period_start IS NULL OR period_start <= DATE(#{settlementDate})) ORDER BY pay_deadline ASC, payment_id ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_paid, 0)), 0) FROM biz_contract_payment WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND COALESCE(direction, 'receivable') = 'receivable' AND period_start > DATE(#{settlementDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_contract_payment SET amount_due = COALESCE(amount_paid, 0), pay_status = '1', pay_time = COALESCE(pay_time, #{settlementDate}), special_bill_type = 'termination_cancelled', remark = CONCAT_WS('；', NULLIF(remark, ''), '退租结算：验收日后未发生账单已终止'), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND COALESCE(direction, 'receivable') = 'receivable' AND COALESCE(pay_status, '0') != '1' AND period_start > DATE(#{settlementDate}) AND COALESCE(special_bill_type, '') != 'termination_cancelled'
